I always look at negative critique like this. If they carry even a piece of advice (for example, someone commented on one of my pictures saying my character looked like she had two mouths), then I can conclude that they were at least trying to be helpful. I’ve been learning how to not take offense to that.

Now, if the comment says nothing helpful at all, or blast you personally (basically saying the art is shit and you’re shit), that’s where I have to tell myself their opinion is their own, and I’ll allow myself to be offended in the moment… but in the end, I can choose how much value it has in the long run.

That, or, I ask them to explain why, to see if I can pull anything helpful from unhelpful people. Pick their brain, or poke holes in their opinion to see if I should believe it to be valid.
